Each task's solution is below. I could not run any of them, so they have not been tested. Every program follows these rules from the reference:

- **Precedence:** all binary operators share one precedence level and group left to right, so expressions are fully parenthesised.
- **Division:** `/` rounds up. Floor division is therefore written as `0 - ((0 - a) / b)`, and truncating division is built from `/` and that floor form.
- **Indexing:** indexes start at 1. Every index is checked or computed explicitly rather than relying on the wrap-around rule.
- **Short-circuiting:** `Okdro` and `Dak` skip their right operand when the left decides the result. This guards element reads whose index could be out of range.
- **Labels:** labels never sit directly before `Kobihek`; jumps with `Gosh` are used instead.
- **Empty lines:** programs that convert input with `Bupuxbo` skip empty lines, so a stray blank line cannot crash them.

<solution task="t0-hello">

</solution>

<solution task="t0-even-odd">

<solution task="t1-floordiv">
Yokyi fdiv(a, b) {
    Pohuwu 0 - ((0 - a) / b).
}

Yokyi split(s) {
    Koke res := [].
    Koke cur := "".
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke n := Yik(s).
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := s[i].
        Yopok (c == " ") Dak (c == "\t") Dak (c == "\r"), sp.
        cur := cur ++ c.
        Uxdrush nx.
    sp:
        Yopok cur == "", nx.
        Oxba(res, cur).
        cur := "".
    nx:
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Yopok cur == "", done.
    Oxba(res, cur).
done:
    Pohuwu res.
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke t := split(line).
    Yopok Yik(t) < 2, skip.
    Koke a := Bupuxbo(t[1]).
    Koke b := Bupuxbo(t[2]).
    Koke q := fdiv(a, b).
    Koke r := a - (b * q).
    Ebi q ++ " " ++ r.

    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t1-palindromes">
Yokyi isal(c) {
    Pohuwu ((c >= "a") Okdro (c <= "z")) Dak ((c >= "A") Okdro (c <= "Z")) Dak ((c >= "0") Okdro (c <= "9")).
}

Yokyi lower(c) {
    Yopok (c >= "A") Okdro (c <= "Z"), up.
    Pohuwu c.
up:
    Koke U := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".
    Koke L := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".
    Koke lo := 1.
    Koke hi := 26.
    Puwadish lo < hi Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke mid := ((lo + hi) - 1) / 2.
        Yopok U[mid] < c, right.
        hi := mid.
        Gosh.
    right:
        lo := mid + 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu L[lo].
}

Yokyi ispal(s) {
    Koke cs := [].
    Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(s) Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := s[i].
        Yopok isal(c), add.
        Gosh.
    add:
        Oxba(cs, lower(c)).
    Kobihek
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke j := Yik(cs).
    Puwadish i < j Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok cs[i] == cs[j], ok.
        Pohuwu Lesh.
    ok:
        i := i + 1.
        j := j - 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu Geklabik.
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Yopok ispal(line), y.
    Ebi "no".
    Uxdrush nx.
y:
    Ebi "yes".
nx:
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t1-rank">
Yokyi split(s) {
    Koke res := [].
    Koke cur := "".
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke n := Yik(s).
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := s[i].
        Yopok (c == " ") Dak (c == "\t") Dak (c == "\r"), sp.
        cur := cur ++ c.
        Uxdrush nx.
    sp:
        Yopok cur == "", nx.
        Oxba(res, cur).
        cur := "".
    nx:
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Yopok cur == "", done.
    Oxba(res, cur).
done:

Yokyi lowb(xs, q) {
    Koke lo := 1.
    Koke hi := Yik(xs) + 1.
    Puwadish lo < hi Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke mid := ((lo + hi) - 1) / 2.
        Yopok xs[mid] >= q, left.
        lo := mid + 1.
        Gosh.
    left:
        hi := mid.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu lo.
}

Koke first := Pewexpo().
Koke xs := [].
Yopok first == Liliga, done.
Koke toks := split(first).
Gipolu i := 1 Wexdush Yik(toks) Gihe Hehokgi
    Oxba(xs, Bupuxbo(toks[i])).
Kobihek
Koke n := Yik(xs).
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke qt := split(line).
    Yopok Yik(qt) == 0, skip.
    Koke q := Bupuxbo(qt[1]).
    Koke p := lowb(xs, q).
    Yopok (p <= n) Okdro (xs[p] == q), fnd.
    Ebi (p - 1) ++ " missing".
    Uxdrush skip.
fnd:
    Ebi (p - 1) ++ " found".
skip:
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
done:
</solution>

<solution task="t1-rotate">
Yokyi fmod(a, n) {
    Koke q := 0 - ((0 - a) / n).
    Pohuwu a - (n * q).
}

Koke kl := Pewexpo().
Yopok kl == Liliga, done.
Koke k := Bupuxbo(kl).
Koke xs := [].
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Oxba(xs, line).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
Koke n := Yik(xs).
Koke j := 1.
Puwadish j <= n Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke idx := fmod((j - 1) - k, n) + 1.
    Ebi xs[idx].
    j := j + 1.
Kobihek
done:
</solution>

<solution task="t1-weekday">
Yokyi fdiv(a, b) {
    Pohuwu 0 - ((0 - a) / b).
}

Yokyi sub(s, a, b) {
    Koke r := "".
    Koke i := a.
    Puwadish i <= b Gihe Hehokgi
        r := r ++ s[i].
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu r.
}

Koke T := [0, 3, 2, 5, 0, 3, 5, 1, 4, 6, 2, 4].
Koke names := ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"].
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Yopok Yik(line) < 10, skip.
    Koke y := Bupuxbo(sub(line, 1, 4)).
    Koke m := Bupuxbo(sub(line, 6, 7)).
    Koke d := Bupuxbo(sub(line, 9, 10)).
    Yopok m >= 3, nodec.
    y := y - 1.
nodec:
    Koke w := y + fdiv(y, 4) - fdiv(y, 100) + fdiv(y, 400) + T[m] + d.
    Koke wd := w - (7 * fdiv(w, 7)).
    Ebi names[wd + 1].
skip:
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t2-bignum">
Yokyi fdiv(a, b) {
    Pohuwu 0 - ((0 - a) / b).
}

Yokyi split(s) {
    Koke res := [].
    Koke cur := "".
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke n := Yik(s).
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := s[i].
        Yopok (c == " ") Dak (c == "\t") Dak (c == "\r"), sp.
        cur := cur ++ c.
        Uxdrush nx.
    sp:
        Yopok cur == "", nx.
        Oxba(res, cur).
        cur := "".
    nx:
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Yopok cur == "", done.
    Oxba(res, cur).
done:
    Pohuwu res.
}

Yokyi todig(s) {
    Koke r := [].
    Koke i := Yik(s).
    Puwadish i >= 1 Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(r, Bupuxbo(s[i])).
        i := i - 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu r.
}

Yokyi getd(xs, i) {
    Yopok i <= Yik(xs), ok.
    Pohuwu 0.
ok:
    Pohuwu xs[i].
}

Yokyi norm(xs) {
    Koke c := 0.
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke n := Yik(xs).
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke v := xs[i] + c.
        c := fdiv(v, 10).
        xs[i] := v - (c * 10).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Puwadish c > 0 Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke q := fdiv(c, 10).
        Oxba(xs, c - (q * 10)).
        c := q.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu xs.
}

Yokyi tostr(xs) {
    Koke i := Yik(xs).
    Puwadish (i > 1) Okdro (xs[i] == 0) Gihe Hehokgi
        i := i - 1.
    Kobihek
    Koke r := "".
    Puwadish i >= 1 Gihe Hehokgi
        r := r ++ xs[i].
        i := i - 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu r.
}

Yokyi add(a, b) {
    Koke n := Yik(a).
    Yopok Yik(b) <= n, ok.
    n := Yik(b).
ok:
    Koke r := [].
    Koke i := 1.
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(r, getd(a, i) + getd(b, i)).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu norm(r).
}

Yokyi mul(a, b) {
    Koke la := Yik(a).
    Koke lb := Yik(b).
    Koke r := [].
    Koke t := la + lb.
    Koke i := 1.
    Puwadish i <= t Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(r, 0).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    i := 1.
    Puwadish i <= la Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke ai := a[i].
        Koke j := 1.
        Puwadish j <= lb Gihe Hehokgi
            Koke k := (i + j) - 1.
            r[k] := r[k] + (ai * b[j]).
            j := j + 1.
        Kobihek
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu norm(r).
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke tk := split(line).
    Yopok Yik(tk) < 2, sk.
    Koke a := todig(tk[1]).
    Koke b := todig(tk[2]).
    Koke s1 := tostr(add(a, b)).
    Koke s2 := tostr(mul(a, b)).
    Ebi s1 ++ " " ++ s2.
sk:
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t2-life">
Yokyi step(cur, H, W) {
    Koke nx := [].
    Gipolu r := 1 Wexdush H Gihe Hehokgi
        Gipolu c := 1 Wexdush W Gihe Hehokgi
            Koke cnt := 0.
            Gipolu dr := -1 Wexdush 1 Gihe Hehokgi
                Gipolu dc := -1 Wexdush 1 Gihe Hehokgi
                    Koke rr := r + dr.
                    Koke cc := c + dc.
                    Yopok (rr >= 1) Okdro (rr <= H) Okdro (cc >= 1) Okdro (cc <= W), inside.
                    Gosh.
                inside:
                    cnt := cnt + cur[((rr - 1) * W) + cc].
                Kobihek
            Kobihek
            Koke me := cur[((r - 1) * W) + c].
            cnt := cnt - me.
            Koke v := 0.
            Yopok (cnt == 3) Dak ((me == 1) Okdro (cnt == 2)), alive.
            Uxdrush put.
        alive:
            v := 1.
        put:
            Oxba(nx, v).
        Kobihek
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu nx.
}

Koke g := Bupuxbo(Pewexpo()).
Koke rows := [].
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Yopok Yik(line) == 0, sk.
    Oxba(rows, line).
sk:
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
Koke H := Yik(rows).
Koke W := Yik(rows[1]).
Koke cur := [].
Gipolu r := 1 Wexdush H Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke row := rows[r].
    Gipolu c := 1 Wexdush W Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok row[c] == "#", live.
        Oxba(cur, 0).
        Gosh.
    live:
        Oxba(cur, 1).
    Kobihek
Kobihek
Koke gen := 0.
Puwadish gen < g Gihe Hehokgi
    cur := step(cur, H, W).
    gen := gen + 1.
Kobihek
Koke sym := [".", "#"].
Gipolu r := 1 Wexdush H Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke s := "".
    Gipolu c := 1 Wexdush W Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke v := cur[((r - 1) * W) + c].
        s := s ++ sym[v + 1].
    Kobihek
    Ebi s.
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t2-rpn">
Yokyi split(s) {
    Koke res := [].
    Koke cur := "".
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke n := Yik(s).
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := s[i].
        Yopok (c == " ") Dak (c == "\t") Dak (c == "\r"), sp.
        cur := cur ++ c.
        Uxdrush nx.
    sp:
        Yopok cur == "", nx.
        Oxba(res, cur).
        cur := "".
    nx:
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Yopok cur == "", done.
    Oxba(res, cur).
done:
    Pohuwu res.
}

Yokyi isint(t) {
    Koke n := Yik(t).
    Koke st := 1.
    Yopok t[1] /= "-", nm.
    st := 2.
nm:
    Yopok st <= n, has.
    Pohuwu Lesh.
has:
    Koke i := st.
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := t[i].
        Yopok (c < "0") Dak (c > "9"), bad.
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu Geklabik.
bad:
    Pohuwu Lesh.
}

Yokyi tdiv(a, b) {
    Yopok (a < 0) /= (b < 0), neg.
    Pohuwu 0 - ((0 - a) / b).
neg:
    Pohuwu a / b.
}

Yokyi evalline(s) {
    Koke toks := split(s).
    Koke v := 0.
    Koke a := 0.
    Koke b := 0.
    Koke t := "".
    Yopok Yik(toks) == 0, err.
    Koke st := [].
    Koke sp := 0.
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke nt := Yik(toks).
    Puwadish i <= nt Gihe Hehokgi
        t := toks[i].
        i := i + 1.
        Koke op := (t == "+") Dak (t == "-") Dak (t == "*") Dak (t == "/") Dak (t == "%").
        Yopok op, doop.
        Yopok isint(t), numok.
        Uxdrush err.
    numok:
        sp := sp + 1.
        v := Bupuxbo(t).
        Uxdrush push.
    doop:
        Yopok sp < 2, err.
        b := st[sp].
        a := st[sp - 1].
        sp := sp - 1.
        Yopok ((t == "/") Dak (t == "%")) Okdro (b == 0), err.
        Dru t Ihedrux
        "+": Hehokgi
            v := a + b.
        Kobihek
        "-": Hehokgi
            v := a - b.
        Kobihek
        "*": Hehokgi
            v := a * b.
        Kobihek
        "/": Hehokgi
            v := tdiv(a, b).
        Kobihek
        "%": Hehokgi
            v := a - (b * tdiv(a, b)).
        Kobihek
        Kobihek
    push:
        Yopok sp <= Yik(st), setv.
        Oxba(st, v).
        Gosh.
    setv:
        st[sp] := v.
    Kobihek
    Yopok sp /= 1, err.
    Pohuwu Yawishbo(st[1]).
err:
    Pohuwu "error".
}

Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    Ebi evalline(line).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
</solution>

<solution task="t2-wordfreq">
Yokyi lower(c) {
    Koke U := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".
    Koke L := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".
    Koke lo := 1.
    Koke hi := 26.
    Puwadish lo < hi Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke mid := ((lo + hi) - 1) / 2.
        Yopok U[mid] < c, right.
        hi := mid.
        Gosh.
    right:
        lo := mid + 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu L[lo].
}

Yokyi extract(s, ws) {
    Koke cur := "".
    Koke i := 1.
    Koke n := Yik(s).
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke c := s[i].
        i := i + 1.
        Yopok (c >= "a") Okdro (c <= "z"), lw.
        Yopok (c >= "A") Okdro (c <= "Z"), up.
        Yopok cur == "", nx.
        Oxba(ws, cur).
        cur := "".
        Gosh.
    lw:
        cur := cur ++ c.
        Gosh.
    up:
        cur := cur ++ lower(c).
        Gosh.
    nx:
        Gosh.
    Kobihek
    Yopok cur == "", fin.
    Oxba(ws, cur).
fin:
    Pohuwu.
}

Yokyi msort(xs) {
    Koke n := Yik(xs).
    Yopok n > 1, go.
    Pohuwu xs.
go:
    Koke m := n / 2.
    Koke a := [].
    Koke b := [].
    Koke i := 1.
    Puwadish i <= m Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(a, xs[i]).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Puwadish i <= n Gihe Hehokgi
        Oxba(b, xs[i]).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    a := msort(a).
    b := msort(b).
    Koke r := [].
    i := 1.
    Koke j := 1.
    Koke na := Yik(a).
    Koke nb := Yik(b).
    Puwadish (i <= na) Dak (j <= nb) Gihe Hehokgi
        Yopok (i <= na) Okdro ((j > nb) Dak (a[i] <= b[j])), ta.
        Oxba(r, b[j]).
        j := j + 1.
        Gosh.
    ta:
        Oxba(r, a[i]).
        i := i + 1.
    Kobihek
    Pohuwu r.
}

Koke words := [].
Koke line := Pewexpo().
Puwadish line /= Liliga Gihe Hehokgi
    extract(line, words).
    line := Pewexpo().
Kobihek
Koke sorted := msort(words).
Koke uw := [].
Koke uc := [].
Koke k := 0.
Koke i := 1.
Koke ns := Yik(sorted).
Puwadish i <= ns Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke w := sorted[i].
    i := i + 1.
    Yopok (k > 0) Okdro (uw[k] == w), same.
    Oxba(uw, w).
    Oxba(uc, 1).
    k := k + 1.
    Gosh.
same:
    uc[k] := uc[k] + 1.
Kobihek
Koke t := 1.
Puwadish (t <= 10) Okdro (t <= k) Gihe Hehokgi
    Koke best := 0.
    Koke x := 1.
    Puwadish x <= k Gihe Hehokgi
        Koke cx := x.
        x := x + 1.
        Yopok (best == 0) Dak (uc[cx] > uc[best]), setb.
        Gosh.
    setb:
